\begin{example} \end{example}[The Special Unitary Group]

1. ch7:7.30$\mathrm{SU}(n)=\mathrm U(n)\cap \mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb C)$ is a properly embedded Lie subgroup of $\mathrm U(n)$ of dimension $n^2-1$, and hence is embedded in $\mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb C)$. \end{example}
